question_text: Describe two protections for confidential traffic sent over a public Wi-Fi hot spot:an encrypted application protocol and a staff VPN.
adaptation_rationale: Focuses broad old countermeasure list on explicitly listed encryptedprotocolsandVPN s; does not claim encryption prevents physical signal capture.
solution: Use an encrypted application protocol such as HTTPS/TLS.; It protects application content from passive readers of the network traffic.; Establish an encrypted VPN tunnel to the organization.; Traffic inside that tunnel is protected in transit between its end points, assuming trusted/verified end points.
